note: Small Inyo NF campground in the pines at 9,600 ft where Saddlebag Lake Rd leaves Hwy 120, just east of Yosemite's Tioga Pass entrance. Only sites 1-5 take RVs; sites 6-13 are for single vehicles to 18 ft, and the narrow gravel road beyond site 5 is not recommended for trailers or large vehicles. No drinking water. --Claude
